name: app-header
title: App header
description: The lab's header: breadcrumb <taste.lab logo> / <lab> / <round menu>, icon-only page toggles and theme switch in a roomy 64px top bar, and on Compare a round tier with arrows, the round id and component, the pick or error badge and "n of N answered" with a bar.

Question moves to the answer bar. The tier keeps the round id and component.

rules: Two tiers. Top bar: breadcrumb <taste.lab logo> / <name> / <round menu> (logo: round-017 a, round-018 b); the round segment opens a menu of every round with its status (round-001 mix, round-002 b).

Round tier on Compare pages only: prev and next, round id and component, the pick or error badge, "n of N answered" with a bar. The question lives in the answer bar (round-001 mix, round-002 b, round-019 d).
Page nav as icon-only outline toggles with names in tooltips, 44px tall and at least 48px wide (round-015 mix).
Roomy tiers: 64px top bar and 48px round tier, both with 32px horizontal padding and 16px gaps (round-015 mix).
Plain 20px icons at stroke 1.75, no tiles: GalleryHorizontal, Library, Paintbrush, ScrollText, CircleArrowLeft/Right, Sun/Moon (round-016 b).
Off Compare, the breadcrumb names the page and the round tier is hidden (round-002 b).
Never list every round as a button in the header (round-001 a).
Don't shrink page icons to fit (round-001 d).
